task.title: Obtaining build trigger credentials
task.shortdesc: To configure your custom Git trigger, you can obtain the SSH public key and webhook endpoint URL from the Red Hat Quay user interface. These credentials are available on the Builds page of your repository.

ul.li: You have created a custom Git trigger.

step.cmd: On the Builds page of your repository, click the menu kebab for your custom Git trigger.
Save the SSH Public Key and Webhook Endpoint URL.

info.p: The key and the URL are available by selecting View Credentials from the Settings, or gear icon.
